summary: Veralto Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $725M offering of 4.850% senior notes due 2032. The notes are unsecured, unsubordinated obligations, issued at 99.996% of par, with an underwriting discount of 0.600% and net proceeds of ~$720.6M. Interest is paid semi-annually; optional redemption provisions apply. There is no change of control or listing. This is a straight debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
